_comment: Mods that are blood magic as a whole, named by plugin file (user decision,
2026-10-10). This is a name rule, not a record rule: the record and keyword
10_everdamned.json) stay the primary source. With the keyword frameworks
installed these lines add nothing on the pinned dump; they matter on a load
order without KIT/OCF/ADAR, where most of Bloodmoon's drains carry no blood
Each line asks for one effect that is hostile and touches Health (damage or
absorb), so a mod's buffs, wards and utility spells are not blood.
Summons and reanimations stay out: 00_mgef.json removes blood from every
SummonCreature and Reanimate spell, and removes run after all adds.
Full file names with the extension, since pluginContains matches any part
of the name. A renamed or merged plugin turns its line off without a word.
AncientBlood II is not here: its boss fire and shock spells would be blood.
